id: \bI used to be a Trainer like you.
en: \bI used to be a Trainer like you.
it: \bUn tempo ero un Allenatore come te.

id: \bThat's right, I even came close to winning the Hoenn League.
en: \bThat's right, I even came close to winning the Hoenn League.
it: \bEsatto, sono persino andato vicino a vincere la Lega di Hoenn.

id: \bA little advice for you. Love your Pokémon like family. It will carry you far.
en: \bA little advice for you. Love your Pokémon like family. It will carry you far.
it: \bUn piccolo consiglio per te. Ama i tuoi Pokémon come una famiglia. Ti porterà lontano.

id: \bKeep moving. This is a quiet town and I like it that way.
en: \bKeep moving. This is a quiet town and I like it that way.
it: \bCircola. Questa è una città tranquilla e mi piace così.
